excerpt: Otonomo ran a platform for connected-car data. It merged into roadside assistance company Urgently in 2023, and Agero agreed to buy Urgently in 2026.
content:
Otonomo Technologies was an Israeli company that built a platform for connected-car data. Urgently's filings with the US Securities and Exchange Commission describe Otonomo's business as an automotive data platform connecting car manufacturers, drivers, insurers and service providers, turning anonymised mobility data into business insights. Third-party analytics tools were built on its data; one example on Wikimedia Commons shows Los Angeles traffic analysed in the xyzt.ai platform.

Otonomo listed on Nasdaq in 2021 through a merger with a special purpose acquisition company, but its market value fell sharply afterwards.

Merger with Urgently

In February 2023 Otonomo agreed to an all-stock merger with Urgently, a US digital roadside assistance company; S&P Global Mobility reported that Urgently holders would own about 67% of the combined company and Otonomo holders about 33%. The deal closed on 19 October 2023, when Otonomo became a wholly owned subsidiary of Urgently, which then traded on Nasdaq as ULY. Urgently's filings show Otonomo contributing about $3.3 million in revenue in the first half of 2024.

Agero deal

On 13 March 2026 Agero, a driver assistance services company, announced an agreement to acquire Urgently for $5.50 a share in cash through a tender offer. Urgently's website now says it has joined forces with Agero.

Pricing

Otonomo's data services were sold under contract and it never published a price list. It is no longer marketed as a separate brand; Urgently's website focuses on roadside assistance software.

This page is based on Urgently's SEC filings and website, S&P Global Mobility's report on the merger and Agero's announcement.
